[LEXP.1.5] The postfix operators — member access `.`, index `[ ]`, call `( )`,
and the conversion cast `::` — bind tighter than every prefix and infix
operator: they are level 17 of [LGRA.9.2.1], the tightest operator level. The
`::` cast is specified in [LCST.4.1]; `x::Int? ?? 0` parses as
`(x::Int?) ?? 0`.
